title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
abstract: arXiv:2610.32245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate "laws" at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting: which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent - one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts - already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader. The compression-ranked top band of the agent's ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities - enrichment $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ under a hypergeometric test - with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. translated_title: 最小描述长度在自我改进科学智能体中无监督地区分定律级知识与统计级知识——并揭示其自身86%的发现属于统计级
translated_abstract: 能够发现科学关系的AI系统如今可以大规模生成候选“定律”，但瓶颈已从生成转移到审查环节：哪些候选值得相信？我们展示了一个已部署的自我改进科学智能体——它已通过留出预测法庭机制接纳了252个关系——本身已经在计算能回答这一问题的量：用于模型选择的最小描述长度压缩比，在离散记账方式下读取时，可充当一种无监督的认知评级器。该智能体账本中按压缩比排名的最高区间恰好恢复了其发现中的全部经典定律（涵盖七大行星的活力公式、巴尔末/里德伯公式）以及跨测量恒等式——在超几何检验下富集显著性 p=3.6×10⁻¹²——且零反例，并呈现出物理上连贯的区间结构。同一视角还回溯性地揭示，账本中86%的内容并未压缩任何信息（cr≈1）：
tldr: 最小描述长度压缩比可作为一种无监督的认知评级器，从自我改进科学智能体的发现中精准识别出真正的物理定律，同时揭示其86%的发现仅为统计级知识而非定律级知识。
en_tdlr: Minimum Description Length compression ratio serves as an unsupervised epistemic grader that perfectly recovers canonical physical laws from a self-improving science agent's discoveries, while revealing that 86% of its own findings are merely statistical-grade rather than law-grade knowledge.
